# The Bennett Hall Band

> The Bennett Hall Band released We Love Country Music in 2024. The trio is made up of three sisters, Kat, Presley and Josie Hope.

## Facts
- Who: The Bennett Hall Band is a folk and indie rock trio.
- Genre: Folk, Indie rock, Country, Folk rock
- Based in: Nashville, TN
- Latest release: We Love Country Music (2024)
- Next show: None announced right now.
- Booking: info@thebennetthallband.com

## Music
